description: Read a file attached to an idea. Text, markdown, CSV, JSON and source files come back as their contents; Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF documents come back as their extracted text; images come back as the image itself. A PDF whose text cannot be extracted — a scan, or a protected file — comes back as a URL to open instead. Call get_idea first: it lists every attachment with the id and the filename this tool takes.

file_id.description: The file's id, from the FILES section of get_idea. Prefer it over filename — two attachments on one idea may share a name.

filename.description: The file's name, exactly as get_idea lists it. Used only when file_id is not given.

idea_short_id.description: The first 8 characters of the idea UUID, visible in the idea URL.

workspace_slug.description: The workspace slug from the idea URL (e.g. 'monnet-team-410b').

name: read_idea_file
